dedupe_keys.name: spatiotemporal levee erosion and wavefront velocity dataset from in situ wave overtopping experiments

description: Spatiotemporal levee erosion and wavefront velocity dataset from in-situ wave overtopping experiments is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Masoumeh Ebrahimi et al. During extreme storm events, waves that run-up and overtop levees cause a significant hydraulic load on the landside slopes. In order to determine the effects of these loads on the flood risk, it is necessary to determine the sensitivity of the landside slope to erosion. Models exist for determining the erosion resistance of grass covers to wave overtopping. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The only repository address found in the article is the code repository in GitHub named in its Code Availability section; the data may be hosted elsewhere, as the Data Records section of the article states. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
